Alex Lambert, pictured above competing over 200 metres at Kingsmeadow, became Surrey County A.A. Under 17 Men's 400 metres champion in 1998
It was certainly an occasion when Alex' Lambert won his spurs in the after-dinner speeches stakes with an address that had one or two of the audience reduced to tears of laughter!
The tweaked hamstring suffered by Alex Lambert, in the 200m gave John Wells the responsibility of running the A string 400m. This he did with a PB of 53.3 to take an excellent second place.
